# #2978: Patch: the fuzz monitor's unlisted-action check forges plays too: a card or a zone the legal list leaves out must be refused
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The game has two separate pieces of code that must agree: one lists what a player may do, the other checks a move when it arrives. Online, the server only uses the second, so if it accepts a move the first never offered, a modified client could, say, play a card into a lane the game shows as closed. The random-game checker compares the two for attacks, position switches and activations, but never for playing a card. Once built, it also tries the plays the list left out, and fails when one is accepted.

## Why
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs:30-33`: "I8 every attack, switch and activation `reduce` accepts is listed ... Not probed: ... `play` and a well-formed `answer` (R90, #992)". `unlisted_accepted` (lines 1039-1104) forges only `SwitchPosition`, `Attack` and `Activate`.
- The list and the reducer are separate code for the same rules: `legal_zones_for` (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:559-604`) against `refuse_zone` (2489-2567), and `play_actions_for` (1845) against `validate_play` (`crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs:572-676`).
- R90's bound, the reason plays were left out, drops choice combinations, never a zone or a card: every legal zone is listed (`play_choices.rs:2348-2372`). So forging at the card and zone level is exact.
- The fuzz's malformed probe forges only impossible values (`UNOFFERED_LANE`, `invariants.rs:1188-1189`), never a real lane that is taken, locked or in the wrong row.

## Proposal
In `unlisted_accepted`:
- Card level: each hand card, and each graveyard card a permission allows, that no listed `Play` names must be refused when sent with the default zone, the smallest X and no other choices.
- Zone level: for each group of listed plays of one card sharing X, embiggen, equip, tributes and face-down, re-send one into each unit or backrow zone the group never lists; any acceptance is a finding, "I8 unlisted play accepted".
- A play sent with no zone is not forged where the card has listed plays, since the reducer picks a default zone.
- A stride constant beside `I8_GATE_STRIDE` if the sweep's time needs it, and the header and `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`'s invariant list updated.

## Where it lands
`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` (doc lines), `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`; SPEC §9.1, §10.2, §10.5.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Using the `without(g, left_out)` pattern in `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`: leaving every listed play of a 1-cost Unit into one lane out of the list is reported; leaving every play of a card out is reported. Both fail today.
- [ ] The full list on a board with locked zones, a Stack pile, a Flying unit, a Tribute card and a carrier reports nothing.
- [ ] The 200-seed fuzz gate passes, or each mismatch it finds is fixed with its ruling in the issue's block.
- [ ] The PR states the fuzz gate's and the test sweep's time before and after, within CI's budget.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 3 files, 150 to 200 lines. Run time is the risk: up to about a hundred extra reduces per checked state, and I8 on every state already cost 103 s against 314 s when measured (`invariants.rs:72-75`), so the test sweep may need its own stride. Any real mismatch found needs a ruling.

Update the I8 header (lines 30-33) to `every attack, switch, activation and play reduce accepts is listed`, removing `` `play` `` from the Not-probed list (keep `a well-formed answer (R90, #992)` there). Update `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` lines 17-21: `no unlisted play, attack, switch or activation reduce accepts`. Append to `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.2's final `legalActions` sentence (`it lists activate from the same check that refuses one ([[R384]])`) the clause `; every play reduce accepts is listed, the zone and the choices read by the same checks on both sides ([[R90]])`.

If any forged play is accepted on the full list (a real mismatch, not a test artifact): stop, fix the list or the reducer (whichever the spec convicts), and file the ruling in the issue's block — `spec/rulings/R2978000.md` (lowest free of R2978000+, front matter `id/title/cards/proven_in`), proving test named `fn r2978000_…`, §11 paragraph in new `spec/pending/2978.md` — per CLAUDE.md rule 3 and `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling". No ruling when nothing is found.

## Tests

In `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`, new mod `i8_a_play_reduce_accepts_that_the_list_leaves_out` reusing the file's `scenario`, `legal_actions`, `unlisted_accepted`, `create_invariant_monitor`, `no_violations` imports. Helper `without_matching(g: &Scenario, pred: impl Fn(&ActionBody) -> bool) -> Vec<ActionBody>` returning the full P1 list minus matches (generalizes the existing `without`).

- `i8_fires_when_every_listed_play_of_a_1_cost_unit_into_one_lane_is_left_out`: `scenario(json!({"p1": {"hand": ["core-008"], "mana": 5, "library": ["core-008", "core-008"]}, "p2": {}}))`; take the smallest listed unit lane N for the Vanilla; drop every play with that instance id and `zone == Some(Units, N)`; assert findings non-empty, each `starts_with("I8 unlisted play accepted")`, containing the instance id and `core-008`.
- `i8_fires_when_every_play_of_a_card_is_left_out`: same board; drop every play naming the Vanilla's id; same assertions.
- `i8_is_clean_on_a_board_with_locked_zones_a_stack_pile_a_flying_unit_a_tribute_card_and_a_carrier`: p1 backrow `classicplus-034` (Crater, locks its zone — verify `is_locked` in-test, else play it via `g.act` first), field Vanilla with `core-092` stacked atop (two `g.play` calls), hand `classicplus-051` (Flying), `core-066` (Tribute 1) plus a Vanilla as fodder, backrow `classicplus-033` (carrier), mana 10; assert `unlisted_accepted` on the full list and `create_invariant_monitor(g.state()).unlisted(g.state())` both equal `no_violations()`.

Run the two firing tests before the engine edit (must fail with empty findings — both fail today), then after. Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards i8`, `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets --features testkit -- -D warnings`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`.

## Done when

- [ ] Leaving one lane's plays of a 1-cost Unit out is reported; leaving a whole card's plays out is reported (both failed before the engine change).
- [ ] Full list on the locked/Stack/Flying/Tribute/carrier board reports nothing.
- [ ] 200-seed fuzz gate passes, or each mismatch is fixed with its R2978xxx ruling (step 7).
- [ ] PR states gate and sweep times before/after, within CI's budget; all commands above green.

## Risks

- False positives from R90 truncation: contained by skipping truncated cards (step 3) and reusing a listed choice combination per zone group (step 4); the clean-board test is the tripwire — any finding there means the exactness claim is wrong, do not relax the assertion.
- Cost: up to ~100 extra reduces per checked state; gate impact is small (I8 runs every 100th state) but the `cfg(test)` sweep runs it every state — hence the measured stride contingency (step 6), never raising strides blindly.
- Hidden information (rule 7): forging uses state's own piles plus `playable_from_graveyard`, never `view_for`; finding text names only the acting seat's own card (as the switch/attack arms do).
- Purity (rule 4): only pure reads plus `reduce` on a cloned state, the existing pattern; no new constants outside `config.rs` (rule 9).

## Open questions

None — every choice above follows the issue or the code it cites; the only person-side input is reviewing the before/after times and any ruling a real mismatch forces.
